name: My Happy Marriage
description: Miyo's abusive family deems her worthless – but together with her powerful husband-to-be, her true self and hidden powers slowly begin to shine.

videos.title: The Shape of My Happiness
videos.overview: Miyo's chance to demonstrate what she has learned comes at her first social gathering with her fiancé. Kiyoka introduces her to a distinguished gentleman.

videos.title: The Meeting
videos.overview: Despised by her stepmother and sister, Miyo is treated like a servant in her own home. One day, her father calls her in to discuss her future.

videos.title: About My Husband-to-Be
videos.overview: Determined to be of use, Miyo wakes up early and prepares breakfast, but Kiyoka accuses her of trying to poison him and refuses to take a bite.

videos.title: Our First Date
videos.overview: While Kiyoka takes Miyo out to town, he quickly notices that she behaves very differently from other wealthy daughters he's encountered.

videos.title: The Gift
videos.overview: To surprise Kiyoka with a handmade gift, Miyo goes into town to shop for some material. Meanwhile, Kiyoka pays Miyo's parents a visit.

videos.title: Ripples
videos.overview: Engulfed with jealousy, Kaya tries to thwart Miyo's engagement to Kiyoka. Miyo leaves the house and forgets to bring the good luck charm Kiyoka gave her.

videos.title: Determination and Thunder
videos.overview: Miyo wakes up to her sister and stepmother threatening her. Together with Koji, Kiyoka arrives at the Saimori home and demands to see his fiancée.

videos.title: Glamorous Lady of Summer
videos.overview: Kiyoka accompanies Miyo to the remains of the Saimori home at her request. Later, a stunning visitor comes by their home.

videos.title: Nightmares and Ominous Shadows
videos.overview: Hazuki and Miyo grow closer through their lessons. Worried, Kiyoka tries to get to the bottom of Miyo's relentless nightmares.

videos.title: Drowning in Dreams
videos.overview: Though distressed by her nightmares, Miyo keeps pushing herself to be a supportive wife. Then, Arata Tsuruki comes to speak to her while Kiyoka is away.

videos.title: Summer Cherry Blossoms, and the Mistake
videos.overview: Arata reveals his true identity and introduces Miyo to the grandfather she never knew. They claim they can cure her nightmares — on one condition.

videos.title: My Mother's Legacy
videos.overview: Yoshiro Usuba tells Miyo about how her mother came to marry her father — and why she made a decision that changed her only daughter's life forever.

videos.title: Light in the Darkness
videos.overview: Miyo's powers are everyone's last hope of waking Kiyoka from his unconscious state. But before she can rescue him, she must face the shadow of her past.

videos.title: Another Kudo Residence
videos.overview: While out shopping, Miyo has a chilling vision — only to be surprised by her future father-in-law, who invites her and Kiyoka to their countryside estate.

videos.title: A New Ordeal
videos.overview: Unhappy with her son's engagement, Fuyu commands Miyo to perform housekeeping duties. Meanwhile, Kiyoka makes a shocking discovery at an abandoned house.

videos.title: The Gifted Communion and Demons
videos.overview: As Miyo tries to save a villager using Dream-Sight, Kiyoka battles a demon. Later, Arata shares surprising information on the Gifted Communion's founder.

videos.title: What the Autumn Breeze Brought
videos.overview: Upon returning to the capital, the group has an unsettling encounter with Naoshi Usui. Kiyoka assigns Miyo a bodyguard: the dashing Kaoruko Jinnouchi.

videos.title: Deep Within the Heart
videos.overview: Miyo overhears soldiers disparaging Kaoruko and defends her friend. Later, she has a troubling nightmare. Is it just a dream or a glimpse of the future?

videos.title: The Man Called Naoshi Usui
videos.overview: As Kiyoka rushes to meet Arata at the imperial family's vacation estate, Usui surprises Miyo and her guards at the dojo, revealing a traitor among them.

videos.title: A New Year's Commotion
videos.overview: After a tender New Year's Eve, Miyo and Kiyoka make their first shrine visit together. Meanwhile, Takahito learns of growing unrest in the streets.

videos.title: An Evening Banquet and Distant Snow
videos.overview: At a surprise gathering, Hazuki and her guests share their thoughts on love. Later, Miyo's worries grow after learning of Takahito's ominous vision.

videos.title: Dream Tidings
videos.overview: While Kiyoka's unit investigates a strange demon, the Gifted Communion makes a ruthless move. Miyo enters a foreboding dream where a young Usui awaits.

videos.title: Promise
videos.overview: Determined to save her fiancé, Miyo sneaks out and runs into a young boy with a familiar face. Later, she dreams of a tragic promise from the past.

videos.title: A Resolute Departure
videos.overview: After awakening from her dream, Miyo begins to gather allies for the rescue mission. Will her blossoming powers be enough to save Kiyoka and stop Usui?

videos.title: Feelings Beyond Dreams
videos.overview: In the final battle, Usui overwhelms Kiyoka, trapping him in a terrible nightmare. Desperate to prevent more bloodshed, Miyo dives into the dream.

videos.title: Once Spring Has Come
videos.overview: After the battle, Miyo confides in Arata about her regrets. Kiyoka makes a big life decision. Later, Hazuki surprises Miyo with a heartfelt wedding gift.
